name: Overseas Family School
summary: Pasir Ris IB campus with strong mother-tongue pathways — common shortlist for east-side dual-career households comparing SAS/Woodlands vs OFS.
body: OFS sits in Pasir Ris with IB programmes and a reputation for mother-tongue maintenance beside English-medium learning. Reddit relocation threads often compare OFS + Pasir Ris living against SAS + Woodlands: east-coast/airport convenience vs Johor weekend access. Admissions and language placement deserve an early conversation; housing should follow the school shortlist, not the reverse. Verify current campus map and bus routes on the school site before signing a lease.
waitlistNotes: Language programme capacity can gate offers; ask about vacancy by grade before locking east-side housing.
